documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of INR 1,847 crore for Q2 FY27, up 73% year-on-year, driven by sourcing agility, disciplined procurement, inventory management, and product mix. The company's operations were impacted by geopolitical developments in West Asia and heavy rainfall leading to flooding at Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, though operations were restored in early August and a debottlenecking programme was completed. Management highlighted sustained gross margin spreads, robust first-half performance with PAT at INR 392 crore, and enhancement of rated bank facilities to INR 1,014 crore. Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest ever quarterly profit and strong revenue growth in Q1 FY27, driven by favorable market conditions, agile sourcing, and disciplined execution amid Middle East geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of margins remaining at or around the current level for the whole year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates export revenue and export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.
guidance.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that the PIO category will have a strong and robust growth for the future and the quarters to come.
guidance.quote: we anticipate even our transformer oil that is the PIO category to have a strong and robust growth for the future and the quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continued to see strong traction in PIO, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We continued to see strong traction in PIO, with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially, while in PHPO, we remain focused on addressing changing customer requirements and competitive dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported robust demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers supporting the PIO business.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the industry is expected to grow at more than 5% CAGR globally according to a CRISIL report.
demand_outlook.quote: See, if you look at the CRISIL report, which we did 1.5 years back, the industry is supposed to grow at more than 5% CAGR globally.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong performance was supported by healthy demand across key end-user industries and sustained momentum across product categories.
demand_outlook.quote: Ourstrong performancewas supported by healthy demand across key end-user industries and sustained momentum across product categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The PHPO segment growth was driven by sustained demand from the personal care, healthcare, and pharmaceutical sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The PHPO segment continued to anchor our growth, driven by sustained demand from the personal care, healthcare, and pharmaceutical sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter witnessed encouraging traction in the PIO business reflecting healthy demand across transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: The quarter alsowitnessedencouraging traction in the PIO business, reflecting healthy demand acrosstransformer, power & rubber manufacturers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter to strengthen operating capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We also completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter, strengthening our operating capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Land is available at all plants for the next phase of expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Land available at all plants for the next phase

margins_costs.claim: Gross Margin Spread was sustained at INR 29,128 per kl, which is 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, the consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x Y-o-Y basis to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR 206 crores, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR206 crores compared with INR26 crores in Q1 FY26 and INR37 crores in Q4 FY26, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year and 456% quarter-on-quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spreads expanded to approximately INR 28,145 per kilolitre.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin spreads expanded to approximately INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared with approximately INR 8,274 per kilolitre under a normal operating environment.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread expanded 3.4 times year-on-year to ₹28,145 per kl compared to Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread expanded 3.4x year-on-year to ₹28,145 per kl compared to Q1 FY26

margins_costs.claim: Record performance was driven by healthy revenue growth and robust gross margin spreads despite operating in a dynamic and challenging external environment.
margins_costs.quote: This record performance was driven by healthy revenue growth and robust gross margin spreads despiteoperatingin a dynamic and challenging external environment.

margins_costs.claim: Continued focus on value-added offerings, efficient procurement practices, and cost optimisation initiatives enabled the company to achieve superior margins.
margins_costs.quote: Continued focus on value-added offerings, efficient procurement practices, and cost optimisation initiatives enabled us to achieve superior margins while also supporting volume growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres.
orders_capacity.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: PIO manufacturing volumes went up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.
orders_capacity.quote: The PIO is a tender-based industry. But on a consolidated basis, Vinit, the PIO manufacturing volumes have gone up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.

orders_capacity.claim: Company capacity utilization across all three plants taken together is around 97% on a two-shift basis.
orders_capacity.quote: On a company level, all 3 plants taken together, it's around 97%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity stands at 597,403 kl across three plants in India and the UAE.
orders_capacity.quote: 597,403 kL across three plants in India and the UAE

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes for the quarter improved 8% year-on-year to 1,31,449 kl.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes for the quarter improved 8% year-on-year to 1,31,449 kl

orders_capacity.claim: Taloja facility is operating near 100% utilisation.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL reaffirmed ratings and bank facilities were enhanced to INR 1,014 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: The reaffirmation of our credit ratings by CRISIL and enhancement of our rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore further strengthen our financial flexibility.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of its share.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

capital_allocation.claim: The standalone company is effectively debt-free.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a strong financial position on a stand-alone basis. We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of face value.
capital_allocation.quote: Declared Interim Dividend 100% of Face Value

capital_allocation.claim: Future growth is funded internally on a debt-free base.
capital_allocation.quote: Growth funded internally on a debt-free base

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia impacted base oil availability, pricing, and shipping logistics during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter presented operational challenges, particularly due to geopolitical developments in West Asia, which impacted base oil availability, pricing and shipping logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy rainfall and flooding caused disruption at the Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Following the disruption caused by heavy rainfall and flooding at our Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, we restored operations in early August through the focused efforts of our teams.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted challenges from heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East and concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations at Texol were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment during the quarter remained shaped by geopolitical developments in West Asia, crude oil price volatility, and periodic supply chain disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during the quarter remained dynamic, shaped by geopolitical developments in West Asia, crude oil price volatility, and periodic supply chain disruptions.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that they will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding presence across geographies, and progressing capacity-expansion plans.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding our presence across geographies and progressing our capacity-expansion plans.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates that margins would continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

management_commitments.claim: Clarity on the strategy and revenue potential for the South African arm will emerge in the next 1 or 2 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: The strategy for the South African arm is being worked out. There will be much more clarity being emerging in the next 1 or 2-odd quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
